name: Epic
marketNote: Hospital EMR with a growing Australian footprint across major metropolitan health services.

dragonCopilot.note: Microsoft publishes an unusually deep public integration surface for Epic, covering Hyperdrive, the Haiku and Canto mobile clients, SmartSections, specialty note behaviour and diagnoses/orders. Treat Australian availability as a separate question from integration depth — the integration existing does not mean the product is commercially available here.
